categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in logistics real estate development, including warehousing and storage services, textile fiber manufacturing, and trade. Logistics centers account for approximately 85.62% of total revenue, textile fibers 10.35%, and trade 4.02%. It also engages in commercial building construction and leasing, as well as import and wholesale of alcoholic beverages.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes traditional textile manufacturing processes involving natural cotton, synthetic fibers, and chemical fibers for spinning, weaving, and processing. In logistics, it focuses on warehousing, inventory management, packaging, and distribution services, supported by newly constructed warehousing facilities with GDP and GMP compliant air conditioning for pharmaceuticals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include businesses requiring warehousing and logistics services, particularly in e-commerce and trade sectors. The company serves domestic markets with a focus on logistics centers and textile-related industries. Major customers contribute significant portions of sales, with top clients accounting for over 60% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan, with logistics parks and warehousing facilities located in Yangmei and Pingzhen areas. The company also has subsidiaries and investments in mainland China and international trade activities, but main revenue and operations are domestic.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing warehousing, inventory management, packaging, and distribution services. It also engages upstream in textile fiber production and downstream in real estate leasing and trade activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on expanding logistics infrastructure, including constructing new warehousing buildings with pharmaceutical-grade facilities. The company emphasizes improving operational efficiency, workforce training, maintaining high service quality, and flexible customer-oriented service combinations. No recent R&D expenditures were reported.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through leasing of logistics real estate, warehousing and logistics services, textile fiber sales, and trade activities. The company earns income from rental fees, service charges, and product sales, with no subscription or licensing models mentioned.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from large domestic conglomerates entering the logistics real estate market, often backed by real estate capital. Its competitive advantage lies in owning land acquired at lower historical costs, enabling cost-effective warehousing development compared to peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$924 million, with net profit after tax of NT$211 million, showing significant growth over the prior year. Total assets were about NT$7.66 billion, with equity of NT$1.73 billion. The company has demonstrated steady revenue and profit growth, supported by new logistics facilities coming online.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by leveraging early land acquisition to reduce warehousing construction costs, enabling competitive pricing. It focuses on high-quality logistics services, including specialized pharmaceutical-grade warehousing, flexible service offerings tailored to customer needs, and stable financial management to sustain growth.
